# jamfplatform_pro_user_initiated_enrollment_settings (Data Source)

Read the current Jamf Pro User-Initiated Enrollment settings (UI: Settings → Global → User-initiated enrollment), including the directory-service Access Groups. Singleton — one record per tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_user_initiated_enrollment_settings" "current" {}

output "computer_enrollment_enabled" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_user_initiated_enrollment_settings.current.enable_computer_enrollment
}

output "access_groups" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_user_initiated_enrollment_settings.current.access_group
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `access_group` (Attributes Set) Directory-service Access Groups permitted to perform user-initiated enrollment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_group))
- `account_driven_device_enrollment_ios` (Boolean) Whether Account-Driven Device Enrollment is enabled for institutionally owned mobile devices.
- `account_driven_device_enrollment_macos` (Boolean) Whether Account-Driven Device Enrollment is enabled for institutionally owned computers.
- `account_driven_device_enrollment_visionos` (Boolean) Whether Account-Driven Device Enrollment is enabled for Apple Vision Pro.
- `account_driven_user_enrollment` (Boolean) Whether Account-Driven User Enrollment is enabled for mobile devices.
- `account_driven_user_enrollment_visionos` (Boolean) Whether Account-Driven User Enrollment is enabled for Apple Vision Pro.
- `allow_ssh_only_management_account` (Boolean) Whether the managed local administrator account has SSH access only.
- `create_management_account` (Boolean) Whether a managed local administrator account is created on enrolled computers.
- `developer_certificate` (Attributes) QuickAdd developer signing certificate details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--developer_certificate))
- `enable_computer_enrollment` (Boolean) Whether user-initiated enrollment is enabled for computers.
- `ensure_ssh_running` (Boolean) Whether SSH (Remote Login) is ensured enabled on enrolled computers.
- `hide_management_account` (Boolean) Whether the managed local administrator account is hidden.
- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier. Always `singleton`.
- `launch_self_service` (Boolean) Whether Self Service launches after a computer completes enrollment.
- `management_username` (String) Username for the managed local administrator account.
- `mdm_signing_certificate` (Attributes) Third-party MDM profile signing certificate details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mdm_signing_certificate))
- `merge_managed_apple_account_usernames` (Boolean) Whether matching Managed Apple Account usernames are merged during enrollment.
- `personal_device_enrollment_type` (String) Personal-device enrollment type (deprecated; always `USERENROLLMENT`).
- `profile_driven_enrollment_via_url_institutional` (Boolean) Whether Profile-Driven Enrollment via URL is enabled for institutionally owned mobile devices.
- `profile_driven_enrollment_via_url_personal` (Boolean) Whether Profile-Driven Enrollment via URL is enabled for personally owned mobile devices.
- `restrict_reenrollment` (Boolean) Whether re-enrollment is restricted to authorized users only.
- `sign_quickadd_package` (Boolean) Whether the QuickAdd package is signed with a developer certificate.
- `signing_mdm_profile_enabled` (Boolean) Whether a third-party signing certificate signs the MDM profile.
- `skip_certificate_installation` (Boolean) Whether certificate installation is skipped during enrollment.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--access_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_group`

Read-Only:

- `account_driven_user_enrollment_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Account-Driven User Enrollment is allowed for this group.
- `directory_service_group_id` (String) Identifier of the directory-service group.
- `enterprise_enrollment_enabled` (Boolean) Whether institutional enrollment is allowed for this group.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned Access Group identifier.
- `ldap_server_id` (String) Identifier of the LDAP / directory-service server.
- `name` (String) Display name of the Access Group.
- `personal_enrollment_enabled` (Boolean) Whether personal-device enrollment is allowed for this group.
- `require_eula` (Boolean) Whether members must accept the EULA during enrollment.
- `site_id` (String) Site assigned to devices enrolled through this group.
